reason: Before training I already have my pre-workout or a Monster from GymBeam, and on other days a coffee does it. 80 mg is less than a coffee and half a Monster, so at 55 CZK a can I don't see what it does for me that I'm not already covered for, and cheaper.
objection: Why pay 55 CZK for a can with less caffeine than my espresso? Clean ingredients are nice, but it doesn't fix any problem I actually have.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it on Rohlík or GymBeam as a multipack at around 35-40 CZK a can, so I could add it to my normal order and swap out some of my Monsters without thinking about it.
